upstream_manager.advanced_settings_hint: Usually no changes are needed. Use these options only when finer control over upstream behavior is required.
upstream_manager.timeout_strategy_hint: End requests earlier when an upstream stops responding. Stage limits never extend the total timeout.
upstream_manager.response_header_timeout_hint: Maximum wait for the upstream HTTP status and response headers. Set to 0 to disable this stage limit.
upstream_manager.response_body_first_byte_timeout_hint: Maximum wait from response headers to the first response body byte. Applies to all responses. Set to 0 to disable this stage limit.
upstream_manager.response_body_idle_timeout_hint: Maximum silence after the response body starts. The timer resets whenever new data arrives. Set to 0 to disable.
upstream_manager.sse_keepalive_hint: Send standard SSE comments downstream while the upstream is silent so intermediaries such as Cloudflare do not close the connection. Heartbeats never extend the total timeout.
upstream_manager.sse_keepalive_interval_hint: A heartbeat is sent only when no upstream data has arrived for this interval.
upstream_manager.sse_keepalive_full_warning: Full mode commits HTTP 200 early after a streaming request is recognized. Once the first heartbeat is sent, a later upstream 401, 429, or 5xx can only be recorded in PrismCat logs; the downstream observes a terminated stream instead of the original status.
upstream_manager.outbound_proxy_hint: Controls whether requests to the target use a proxy. Environment: reads HTTP_PROXY / HTTPS_PROXY / NO_PROXY. Custom: provide an http:// or socks5:// URL.
upstream_manager.logging_enabled_hint: When disabled, this upstream only proxies traffic and does not save requests, responses, stats, or traces.
upstream_manager.logging_path_mode_hint: Filtering only affects log collection. Requests are still forwarded and request overrides still run.
upstream_manager.edit_description: Update the upstream connection, timeout strategy, and optional advanced behavior.
upstream_manager.override_enabled_hint: Requires both the global switch and bound rules to take effect.

settings.access_description: Requests are forwarded by subdomain by default. Path-based routing is available as a fallback.
settings.upstreams_description: Configure upstream target servers and routing rules.
settings.section_content_size_desc: Limits for saved request/response bodies and preview size.
settings.section_retention_desc: How long logs are kept and the total storage cap.
settings.section_logging_behavior_desc: When logs are persisted and what content is stored.
settings.section_sensitive_headers_desc: Matching header values are masked in logs, one per line.
settings.copy_path_proxy_url: Click to copy path routing endpoint URL
settings.proxy_domain_suffix_hint: Requests are forwarded via {{name}}.{{suffix}} after adding an upstream.
settings.enable_path_routing_hint: When enabled, requests can also be forwarded through a reserved path prefix, e.g. /_proxy/openai/v1.
settings.path_routing_prefix_hint: A dedicated prefix avoids collisions with UI/API routes. Defaults to /_proxy if empty.
settings.max_request_body_hint: Request content larger than this is truncated and cannot be fully loaded later.
settings.max_response_body_hint: Response content larger than this is truncated and cannot be fully loaded later.
settings.detach_body_over_bytes_hint: Content above this size is still saved completely, but moved from database text into file storage. Set to 0 to disable.
settings.body_preview_bytes_hint: Controls how much readable Body preview is kept when writing logs. Lower it for long-running high-frequency use to reduce write and storage cost; raise it for low-frequency debugging to preview more content immediately.
settings.max_storage_bytes_hint: When total storage (database + blob files) exceeds this limit, oldest unsaved logs are automatically cleaned up. Set to 0 for unlimited.
settings.early_request_body_snapshot_hint: When enabled, request bodies are persisted immediately after being sent upstream, without waiting for a response. May increase database load under high concurrency.
settings.store_base64_hint: When enabled, Base64 data (e.g. images) in bodies will be stored. Disable to significantly reduce storage usage.
settings.request_overrides_warning_title: Outgoing requests will be modified when enabled
settings.request_overrides_warning: Applies to upstreams with overrides enabled and rules bound. Body modifications require buffering; header overrides work on any request type. Original vs. modified diffs are logged.
settings.request_overrides_enable_hint: Global switch. When off, all rules are ignored and requests pass through transparently.
settings.request_overrides_max_body_hint: Requests exceeding this size will skip overrides and return an error.
settings.request_overrides_rules_hint: Each rule has match (conditions), patch (body modifications), and headers (header overrides). Paths use dot notation (e.g. metadata.user_id). Supported ops: set / remove / default / append / prepend. See the rule documentation for exact semantics.
settings.request_overrides_scope_hint: Manage the rule library here. Bind rules to specific upstreams from the Upstreams tab.
settings.request_overrides_rules_must_be_array: Override rules must be a JSON array
settings.request_override_no_rules: No rules yet. Add a rule or insert the example set.
settings.request_override_single_rule_hint: Edit one rule at a time here; advanced JSON is available for bulk import/export.
settings.request_override_rule_must_be_object: Current rule must be a JSON object
settings.request_override_match_hint: Edit only the match object that limits request methods, paths, and JSON conditions.
settings.request_override_match_must_be_object: Match conditions must be a JSON object
settings.request_override_patch_must_be_array: Body modifications must be a JSON array
settings.request_override_final_preview_hint: Generated from the fields above and read-only. Sensitive header values are masked.
settings.request_override_body_patch_hint: Edit only the patch array. Supports set, remove, default, append, and prepend.
settings.request_override_headers_hint: Header operations match by method and path only — they apply even to non-JSON or compressed requests.
settings.request_override_no_headers: No header operations yet. Click Add to set or remove request headers.
settings.usage_extraction_enable_hint: When enabled, token usage is extracted only for upstreams that also enable and bind rules. Extraction failures never block log persistence.

pentest.name: Penetration test review
pentest.description: Review vulnerability and Flag evidence, resource use and responses to failures.

coding.name: Coding task review
coding.description: Review tests, edits and how different Agents or models approached the work.

reverse.name: Reverse engineering review
reverse.description: Review function discovery, logic reconstruction and verification.

blank.name: Custom review
blank.description: Start with duration and tokens, then add observations for your task.

vulnerabilities.name: Valid vulnerabilities
vulnerabilities.hint: Deduplicate by target and vulnerability. Separate claims, reproduction evidence and independent validation; insufficient evidence stays unknown.

flags.name: Flags obtained
flags.hint: Deduplicate by target and Flag, exclude examples and repeated history, and distinguish extracted records from verified Flags.

tokens.name: Token usage
tokens.hint: Use known usage from the logs; missing data is labelled.

duration.name: Duration
duration.hint: First model request to last completed request; this may differ from full task execution time.

errors.name: Errors
errors.hint: HTTP or transport errors; not a measure of task success.

adaptation.name: Adaptation after failure
adaptation.hint: Check whether failures were understood and parameters or approaches were changed.

repetition.name: Ineffective repetition
repetition.hint: Distinguish repeated failures using the same approach from useful verification.

tests.name: Build and test results
tests.hint: Use actual tool output to identify executed, passed, failed and unknown tests, rather than Agent claims alone.

changes.name: Scope of code changes
changes.hint: Use logs or supplied evidence to describe actual edits and their relevance to the task.

understanding.name: Understanding before editing
understanding.hint: Review discovery, reading and validation steps with evidence.

functions.name: Key function discovery
functions.hint: Compare the discovery process, evidence and remaining uncertainty.

logic.name: Key logic reconstruction
logic.hint: Compare explanations of behavior and key logic, separating evidence from guesses.

verification.name: Verification of conclusions
verification.hint: Check whether initial interpretations were tested against actual output.
